exposure: positive severe acute respiratory syndrome-coronavirus-2 (SARS-CoV-2) RNA tests
cohort: 249 pregnant women who tested positive for SARS-CoV-2 at delivery
finding: Pregnant women with symptomatic SARS-CoV-2 infection had worse maternal and fetal outcomes compared to asymptomatic women.
mod_finding: The study found that cesarean section rates were higher among symptomatic pregnant women with positive SARS-CoV-2 RNA tests.
